rules.statement: A fiduciary, as a general rule, becomes the absolute owner of the property left subject to a fidei commissum.
rules.supporting_quote: "This is a rule which applies really to a fidei commissum created by a testamentary document, for in such a case there is a presumption that the testator intended the fidei commissary legatee to have no transmissible interest unless he survives the fiduciary, and if there is no such person, the fiduciary would hold the property free of the burden of the fidei commissum imposed by the testator"
